name: career-match-dev-eval-v0.1
disclaimer: Synthetic resume/job pairs constructed for development ranking checks. Not real candidate data. Not a production benchmark. Legacy category labels from resume_dataset.csv are not used as relevance.

relevance_scale.3: strong match — same role family, most required skills present
relevance_scale.2: moderate match — overlapping stack, missing several required skills
relevance_scale.1: weak match — some shared vocabulary, little required skill coverage

queries.job_text: We need a Machine Learning Engineer to ship Deep Learning models. The role uses Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, NLP, Docker, and AWS. Experience with Git and Linux is expected.

candidates.label: strong
candidates.resume_text: Machine Learning Engineer. Production Deep Learning in Python with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn. Built NLP pipelines, packaged jobs in Docker, and deployed to AWS. Daily Git and Linux.

candidates.label: moderate
candidates.resume_text: Data scientist writing Python, pandas, NumPy, SQL, and scikit-learn models. Some AWS notebooks. No PyTorch or Docker production work.

candidates.label: weak
candidates.resume_text: Analyst comfortable in Python and SQL for monthly reports. Limited modeling beyond spreadsheets and basic pandas charts.

candidates.label: mismatch
candidates.resume_text: Frontend engineer building React and Next.js apps in TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Focused on UI polish, not model training.

queries.job_text: Data Scientist to analyze product funnels with Python, pandas, NumPy, SQL, and scikit-learn. Clear writing and reproducible Git workflows required.

candidates.label: strong
candidates.resume_text: Data Scientist using Python, pandas, NumPy, SQL, and scikit-learn for experiment analysis. Shares notebooks through Git and documents assumptions.

candidates.label: moderate
candidates.resume_text: Backend-leaning analyst: Python, SQL, and pandas for ETL. Light scikit-learn classification, no experiment design.

candidates.label: weak
candidates.resume_text: Java and SQL application developer who occasionally exports CSV files. No pandas or scikit-learn.

candidates.label: mismatch
candidates.resume_text: Platform engineer specializing in Kubernetes, C++, Linux internals, and cluster networking. No analytics stack.

queries.job_text: Backend Engineer for REST APIs in Python using FastAPI or Django, SQL, Docker, AWS, Linux, and Git.

candidates.label: strong
candidates.resume_text: Backend Engineer shipping REST APIs with Python, FastAPI, Django, and SQL. Services run in Docker on AWS Linux hosts. Git-based reviews.

candidates.label: moderate
candidates.resume_text: Python web developer using Flask, SQL, and Git. Some Docker locally. No AWS production ownership.

candidates.label: weak
candidates.resume_text: Writes Python scripts and SQL queries for internal tools. Has used Git. No API framework or containers.

candidates.label: mismatch
candidates.resume_text: Computer Vision researcher training PyTorch models and NLP demos. No web APIs, SQL services, or Docker.

queries.job_text: Frontend Engineer for a TypeScript React and Next.js product. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Git are required.

candidates.label: strong
candidates.resume_text: Frontend Engineer delivering TypeScript React and Next.js features. Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Git habits.

candidates.label: moderate
candidates.resume_text: JavaScript React developer with HTML and CSS. Little TypeScript and no Next.js.

candidates.label: weak
candidates.resume_text: Builds static HTML and CSS landing pages. Rare JavaScript, no React.

candidates.label: mismatch
candidates.resume_text: Systems programmer in C++ on Linux with Kubernetes. No JavaScript or UI work.
